v5.hint.Intro: You can talk 1:1 by phone. The first task starts soon.
v5.hint.TaskPlay: Make your choice; you can change it until time runs out. Bargain on the phone.
v5.hint.Break: Break: phone, transfers and texts are open.
v5.hint.MeetingDossier: Everyone hears everyone. Read the dossier; investigations and leaks are open.
v5.hint.MeetingDiscussion: Discuss. Investigations and leaks are still open.
v5.hint.MeetingVote: Cast blame ballots: one per failed task. An empty ballot goes to yourself.
v5.hint.MeetingVerdict: Blame from this meeting is revealed.
v5.hint.CrisisCalls: Crisis! Phones only (1:1). Bargain over the crisis vote.
v5.hint.CrisisVote: Who takes the crisis blame? One ballot; an empty one goes to yourself.
v5.hint.CrisisVerdict: Crisis blame handed out; the firing candidates are fixed.
v5.hint.FinalDiscussion: Everyone hears everyone. Last bargaining; recordings can be leaked.
v5.hint.FinalDefense: Candidates defend in turn; only the defender can speak.
v5.hint.FinalVote: Vote for a candidate. Only those who voted for the fired player share their desk.
v5.hint.FinalVerdict: The fired player's desk is opened.
v5.hint.Results: Everyone's prim, ballots and choices are revealed.
